summary: Connect an organization's information system to Gosuslugi.

steps.title: Identify the service and environment
steps.detail: Find the service in the partner catalog. Record the specification and verify the organization's TEST access separately.

steps.title: Verify credentials and signing requirements
steps.detail: Check the system registration, organization, certificate, and service contract. Use sample values in the demo.

steps.title: Verify the receipt
steps.detail: Match the application number to the response. Identify the notification channel and the authorized recipient role separately.
